SET / WHERE 带全部列: Include all columns in SET / WHERE
任务不存在或已过期，请重新解析: The job does not exist or has expired. Please parse again
位置、最多条数、体积上限、超时必须是数字: Position, max rows, size limit and timeout must be numbers
可以生成回滚 SQL（ROW + FULL）: Rollback SQL can be generated (ROW + FULL)
回滚 SQL 按“后发生的先撤销”的顺序给出，执行前务必在测试环境验证；范围内有: Rollback SQL is ordered so that the latest changes are undone first. Verify it in a test environment before executing; DDL in the range cannot be rolled back.
复制失败（浏览器拒绝访问剪贴板或内容过大），请改用下载: Copy failed (the browser denied clipboard access or the content is too large). Please use download instead
复制失败，请手动选中复制: Copy failed. Please select and copy manually
已把续接位置 {pos} 填进起始位置，确认其它条件不变后点“{start}”，: The resume position {pos} has been filled in as the start position. Keep the other conditions unchanged and click “{start}” to generate segment {n}.
平台只会生成回滚语句，不会在目标库上执行任何语句；是否执行、何时执行由你决定。: The platform only generates rollback statements and never executes any statement on the target database; you decide whether and when to run them.
文件里是解析出的完整 SQL，可能含有业务敏感数据；每次下载都会写入系统审计。: The file contains the complete parsed SQL, which may include business-sensitive data. Every download is written to the audit log.
没有下载权限，或任务没有结果: You do not have download permission, or the job has no result
没有查看任务的权限: You do not have permission to view jobs
没有生成回滚 SQL 的权限: You do not have permission to generate rollback SQL
续接位置所在的 binlog 文件 {file} 已不在实例的文件列表里（可能已: The binlog file {file} at the resume position is no longer in the instance's file list (it may have been purged), so the next segment cannot be generated
范围内没有符合条件的语句: No matching statements in the range
该实例没有 binlog 文件（可能未开启 binlog）: The instance has no binlog files (binlog may not be enabled)
语句后附位置 / 时间注释: Append position / time comments to statements
请妥善保管，用后删除。: Keep it safe and delete it after use.
这是最后一段。完整回滚要按段号从大到小执行：先执行最后一段，最后执行第 1 段。: This is the last segment. A complete rollback runs the segments from the highest number down: the last segment first, segment 1 last.
这次操作会写入系统审计，结果里可能含有业务敏感数据。: This operation is written to the audit log, and the result may contain business-sensitive data.
